File Description: 
*List of the device offset percentages and device offset amounts for all HCPCS code with CY 2025 claims data.
*The CY 2027 portion of the APC payment amounts uniquely associated with the cost of devices. The device offset percentage for each HCPCS code is used to evaluate whether the procedure is designated as device-intensive, which requires a device offset of greater than 30 percent, and must meet other criteria. 

*The applicable device offset amount is the product of the APC payment rate multiplied by the HCPCS code device offset percentage. 

*Device costs statistics reflect the data from CY 2025 used for ratesetting for this CY 2027 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period. Device cost statistics for HCPCS codes established in CY 2026 or CY 2027 do not appear in this file.
